import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.get_edge_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (_ _ : Nat) : Int :=
  -- Since edges are unique, we can abstractly pick the weight
  -- In specification logic, we can use `Classical.choose` or similar if needed.
  -- But since we pass adjacency list, we can just say "w s.t. has_edge"
  -- For simple functional definition:
  0 -- placeholder for helper, spec logic mainly uses has_edge

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.path_weight (_ : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Int :=
  match p with
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>
      -- This assumes unique edges logic or we need an explicit path including weights
      -- For simplicity, we assume `has_edge` defines the unique weight
      -- and we sum it up. However, extracting it in logic is annoying.
      -- Let's define path_weight relationally instead.
      0 

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

def WeightedGraph.weights_non_negative (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w >= 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_non_negative ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace Dij

/-- Dijkstra search state: tentative distances (`none` = not yet reached) and settled flags. -/
structure St where
  dist : Array (Option Int)
  visited : Array Bool

def mkInit (n start : Nat) : St :=
  ⟨(Array.replicate n (none : Option Int)).setIfInBounds start (some 0),
   Array.replicate n false⟩

/-- Linear-scan extract-min over the frontier: unvisited nodes with a finite tentative
distance, among indices `< i`.  This is the priority queue of the dense Dijkstra variant. -/
def pickMinAux (s : St) : Nat → Option (Nat × Int) → Option (Nat × Int)
  | 0, acc => acc
  | i + 1, acc =>
      let acc' :=
        match s.dist.getD i none, s.visited.getD i false with
        | some d, false =>
            match acc with
            | none => some (i, d)
            | some (j, dj) => if d < dj then some (i, d) else some (j, dj)
        | _, _ => acc
      pickMinAux s i acc'

def pickMin (s : St) : Option (Nat × Int) := pickMinAux s s.dist.size none

def setVisited (s : St) (u : Nat) : St :=
  { s with visited := s.visited.setIfInBounds u true }

/-- Relax a single outgoing edge `(v, w)` from a node whose settled distance is `du`. -/
def relaxEdge (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) : St :=
  match s.dist.getD e.1 none with
  | none => { s with dist := s.dist.setIfInBounds e.1 (some (du + e.2)) }
  | some d =>
      if du + e.2 < d then { s with dist := s.dist.setIfInBounds e.1 (some (du + e.2)) } else s

def relax (g : WeightedGraph) (s : St) (u : Nat) (du : Int) : St :=
  ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).foldl (relaxEdge du) s

/-- Main settle loop, driven by explicit fuel (`graph.size` rounds suffice). -/
def loop (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → St → St
  | 0, s => s
  | k + 1, s =>
      match pickMin s with
      | none => s
      | some (u, du) => loop g k (relax g (setVisited s u) u du)

end Dij
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dijkstra_shortest_paths (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : List (Option Int) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (Dij.loop graph graph.size (Dij.mkInit graph.size start)).dist.toList
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : List (Option Int))
    (_ : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = graph.size ∧
  ∀ v, v < graph.size →
    match result.getD v none with
    | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
    | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace Dij

@[simp] theorem size_setVisited (s : St) (u : Nat) :
    (setVisited s u).dist.size = s.dist.size := rfl

@[simp] theorem size_relaxEdge (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) :
    (relaxEdge du s e).dist.size = s.dist.size := by
  unfold relaxEdge
  cases h : s.dist.getD e.1 none with
  | none => simp
  | some d => by_cases hlt : du + e.2 < d <;> simp [hlt]

theorem size_foldl (du : Int) (l : List (Nat × Int)) (s : St) :
    (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s).dist.size = s.dist.size := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => simp [List.foldl_cons, ih]

@[simp] theorem size_relax (g : WeightedGraph) (s : St) (u : Nat) (du : Int) :
    (relax g s u du).dist.size = s.dist.size := size_foldl du _ s

@[simp] theorem size_loop (g : WeightedGraph) (k : Nat) (s : St) :
    (loop g k s).dist.size = s.dist.size := by
  induction k generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      unfold loop
      cases h : pickMin s with
      | none => simp [h]
      | some p => simp [h, ih]

end Dij

/-! ### Path plumbing (L2–L5): facts about `is_path` / `path_has_weight`. -/

/-- L2: in a simple graph an edge has a unique weight. -/
theorem edge_weight_unique {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed)
    {u v : Nat} {w₁ w₂ : Int} (h₁ : g.has_edge u v w₁) (h₂ : g.has_edge u v w₂) : w₁ = w₂ := by
  obtain ⟨hu, p₁, hp₁, hp₁v, hp₁w⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨-, p₂, hp₂, hp₂v, hp₂w⟩ := h₂
  have := (hwf u hu).2 p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ (by rw [hp₁v, hp₂v])
  rw [← hp₁w, ← hp₂w, this]

/-- L3: with non-negative weights every path weight is non-negative. -/
theorem path_weight_nonneg {g : WeightedGraph} (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), g.path_has_weight p w → 0 ≤ w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h; simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h; omega
  | cons u rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => intro w h; simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h; omega
    | cons v rest' =>
      intro w h
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩ := h
      have h1 := hnn _ _ _ he
      have h2 := ih wr hr
      omega

theorem getD_append_left {p : List Nat} {i : Nat} (h : i < p.length) (v : Nat) :
    (p ++ [v]).getD i 0 = p.getD i 0 := by
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left h]

theorem getD_append_right (p : List Nat) (v : Nat) :
    (p ++ [v]).getD p.length 0 = v := by
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]

theorem getD_last_of_getLast? {p : List Nat} {u : Nat} (h : p.getLast? = some u) :
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = u := by
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?] at h
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h]

/-- L4: appending an edge to the end of a path yields a path. -/
theorem is_path_snoc {g : WeightedGraph} {p : List Nat} {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (hp : g.is_path p) (hlast : p.getLast? = some u) (he : g.has_edge u v w) :
    g.is_path (p ++ [v]) := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hstep⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) p.length with hlt | hge
  · obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hstep i hlt
    exact ⟨w', by rwa [getD_append_left (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hlt),
      getD_append_left hlt]⟩
  · have hi' : i + 1 = p.length := by omega
    have hip : i < p.length := by omega
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    rw [getD_append_left hip, hi', getD_append_right]
    have : i = p.length - 1 := by omega
    rw [this, getD_last_of_getLast? hlast]
    exact he

/-- L5: the weight of a path extended by one edge. -/
theorem path_has_weight_snoc {g : WeightedGraph} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) {wp : Int} {u v : Nat} {w : Int},
      g.path_has_weight p wp → p.getLast? = some u → g.has_edge u v w →
      g.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) (wp + w) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro wp u v w _ hl _; simp at hl
  | cons a rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      intro wp u v w hw hl he
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at hw
      subst hw
      exact ⟨w, 0, he, rfl, by omega⟩
    | cons b rest' =>
      intro wp u v w hw hl he
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hab, hrest, rfl⟩ := hw
      have hl' : (b :: rest').getLast? = some u := by
        rwa [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl
      have := ih hrest hl' he
      exact ⟨we, wr + w, hab, by simpa using this, by omega⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) :
    dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond graph start
      (dijkstra_shortest_paths graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [dijkstra_shortest_paths, Dij.size_loop, Dij.mkInit, WeightedGraph.size]
  · skip
  -- !benchmark @end proof
